sections.title: Overview
sections.content:
needs=History

Calamity Demon Amu Yunos is one of the eight Demon Lords of Ishgria. She rules over the land of Zamburg.

sections.title: Character
sections.content:
Amu Yunos is depicted as the most easy-going demon, compared to other Demon Lords. She also depicted as a bored demon, incredibly bored that she was willing to fixate on anything that appears to be interesting, and when she lose interest in them, they are immediately killed or left to die. Later, it was revealed that Amu Yunos is bored because she lives for too long, so she desires for her death.

As the oldest demon in Ishgria, she was implied to be the strongest demon in the land. Her power is said to be massive even after she relinquished some portion of her power to seal Karna Masta's power. Even so, she can manipulate a volcano to erupt with just a wave of her hand.

sections.title: Trivia
sections.content:
- Amu Yunos actually forced the Summoner to fight her.
- In the Omni Unit lore it is believed that she at full power to be able to go through other worlds.
- In the Ishgrian Expedition Squadron's Grand Quest, it is shown that Amu Yunos can control the fabric of time and space.
- Although her eyes weren't seen, it's revealed through her Omni Rarity form that Amu Yunos has green eyes.
